title: Wanderburg Release Date — Early Access Sep 8, 2026
description: Wanderburg release date and Early Access window: Steam EA schedule, demo availability, and what the 6–12 month EA note means.

paragraphs: According to the Steam store page used in our 关卡3 research, Wanderburg Early Access was scheduled for September 8, 2026.
If you searched wanderburg release date or when will wanderburg be released, start here — then re-check Steam for any schedule changes after launch week.
Developer notes around the launch window estimated roughly 6–12 months in Early Access, with more content and balance work driven by community feedback on Discord and Steam.
Treat that range as a planning estimate, not a hard end date. Patch cadence can shift after players pile in.
A free Steam demo (app 4268810) was available before EA and developer posts during Next Fest said it would remain available for the foreseeable future.
Use the demo to learn driving and early modules; expect unlock pools and balance to expand after the Sep 8 EA build.
